svg.title: Which positions each token may attend to
svg.desc: Four 5 by 5 grids, rows are query tokens and columns are key tokens, filled cells mean allowed. BERT: all 25 cells filled. GPT: lower triangle including the diagonal. Original Transformer: encoder full square, decoder self-attention lower triangle.
svg.text: Filled cell = query row may attend
Cross-attention between the two is unmasked
